title: Knowledge check: Sorting Results with ORDER BY

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies to “Sorting Results with ORDER BY”?
options: Make filtering, ordering and pagination explicit, and test edge cases such as NULL, duplicates and empty result sets.
Rely on undocumented behavior and skip checking the actual SQLite runtime.
Concatenate untrusted input directly into SQL and suppress errors.
Assume the result is correct without checking the schema, data or expected output.
questions.answer_key: Make filtering, ordering and pagination explicit, and test edge cases such as NULL, duplicates and empty result sets.
questions.explanation: Sorting Results with ORDER BY: Make filtering, ordering and pagination explicit, and test edge cases such as NULL, duplicates and empty result sets. SQL result ordering is not guaranteed unless ORDER BY specifies it.
